title: Can I BEAT 1D Chess?
summary: 1D chess (Martin Gardner style) on a website: the board is a single rank of 8 squares. Kings and rooks move normally along the line; knights jump exactly two squares (over one). White has a forced win; the site's Black plays optimal responses and hides the solution in a blacked-out box. Tony draws (stalemate/insufficient material) and loses before finding the forced mate.
rules: Setup: White K N R on squares 1-3, Black r n k on squares 6-8 (mirrored).
King moves 1 square; rook slides any distance; knight jumps exactly 2 squares, over any piece.
Normal check, checkmate, stalemate; insufficient material draws.
White moves first and has a forced win.
win_condition: Checkmate Black's king (forced win for White).
